subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Arrival of Sound: The Jazz Singer
description: One-minute skill: The Arrival of Sound: The Jazz Singer.

hook.text: In 1927, Al Jolson looked at the camera and said, 'You ain't heard nothin' yet.'

buildup.text: The Jazz Singer was the first major feature with synchronized dialogue sequences.

discovery.text: Audiences were stunned. Hearing actors speak felt like witnessing a miracle.

twist.text: Sound killed many silent stars whose voices didn't match their on-screen image.

climax.text: Within two years, silent film was essentially dead as an industry standard.

punchline.text: One sentence ended an entire era.

quiz.question: What was significant about The Jazz Singer (1927)?
